verdict.rationale: Superpowers' own docs say it batches small same-shape tasks into a single subagent dispatch, with batch reviews checking every file in the brief, and that `/execute-plan` runs batched implementation plans across many plan tasks. That is real multi-item batching, but it is scoped to implementation-plan tasks in coding work rather than general bulk operations over arbitrary items, and the evidence is vendor release notes only. Missing for 10: general-purpose bulk operations beyond plan-task batching, documented limits on batch size or parallelism, independent or hands-on corroboration of batched execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Small same-shape tasks batch into one dispatch, cutting subagent cost sharply on micro-task plans; batch reviews verify every file in the brief made it into the diff.
`/execute-plan` to run batched implementation plans with review checkpoints
your agent launches a *subagent-driven-development* process, having agents work through each engineering task, inspecting and reviewing their work, and continuing forward.
